references.text: Abraham also offered milk to his guests, which illustrates the Eastern tradition of hospitality involving giving dairy products to visitors.
Rebekah gave water for Abraham's servant to drink, an example of hospitality where a visitor asks for a drink and receives it.
The earlier prose account in which Jael gave Sisera milk to drink when he asked for water, the same event described poetically in chapter 5.
Refers to churning milk into butter, connecting to the fact that Jael served butter in an ornate bowl.
